system.description: People who back no god, from doubt, abandonment or disbelief; they lack divine protection but mostly avoid divine wrath by going unnoticed.
system.summary: People who back no god, from doubt, abandonment or disbelief; they lack divine protection but mostly avoid divine wrath by going unnoticed.
commandments: Disbelief does not spare you from judgment; follow local ideas of right and sin.
Wishful thinking achieves nothing; only the living create change.
The plainest explanation is usually right.
Lacking a divine mandate, pick your own cause and path.
Secular life guarantees nothing; you stand opposed to cults, gods and daemons alike.

cults.name: The Uninterested
cults.summary: The indifferent majority, outnumbering the faithful, used in numbers games and courted as prizes by rival gods.

cults.name: Militant Atheists
cults.summary: Activists who hate the gods and seek to topple religions by debate, protest and publishing, or by violence.
